OCR text also describes a controls and info area with Start/Stop system, Bag Out, Purge, view Metrics (Destinations), and AGV status.

Robot Location database model: The model includes the station number, occupancy state, zone, closeout zone, location type, maximum number of AGVs allowed at the location, and whether dwell time should be tracked. The training describes the orange locations shown in RMS as including workstation or station identifiers.

Sorter Sweeper Database Overview: The displayed database overview includes field names such as SystemState, Destination, Active Exchange, PackageUid, Status, TrackingNumber, SorterSideName, SortGuid, Station, Zone, ToteName, RobotCode, ExchangeType, SortName, LaneName, and ErrorCode.

Displayed OptiSweep API endpoint categories: The displayed catalog includes System endpoints such as System State, System Startup, System Shutdown, CloseOut, Purge, ResetMetrics, SystemMetrics, and zone configuration operations. AGVS endpoints include status retrieval, fault-related data retrieval, and command-related operations.

CloseOut and Purge behavior: The source associates CloseOut with a customer bag-out and describes it as closing all chutes and exchanging totes with parcels. Purge is described as performing exchanges for every tote in the system and not printing a label.

Sort metrics and reset behavior: The source states that ResetMetrics is called when UPS cycles a sort and generates a new sort GUID so metrics can be tracked. The transcript also mentions Sort Goods as historical information, but the source does not further define its fields or display.

Remove and Recover AGV APIs: RemoveAgv requires the robot ID and sends a request to Geek to remove the specified AGV from the system. RecoverAgv also requires the robot ID and sends a request to Geek to add the specified AGV to the system. The training describes Recover AGV as the equivalent of Add AGV in Geek Plus.

Pause and Resume AGV Movement: PauseAgvs makes a request to Geek to pause all AGV movement. ResumeAgvs makes a request to Geek to resume all AGV movement. The training distinguishes this pause behavior from AE.

Execute Active AGV Command: The ExecutedAgvCommand operation requires a robot ID and executes the active command the AGV has. The training identifies this capability as helpful during unplanned restarts when OptiSweep has missed callbacks from Geek Plus.

Resend Geek Command for retrying a command after Geek+ server restart or error: The transcript states that if the Geek Plus server is restarted, the system retries sending callbacks for some period based on a retry count, and eventually stops sending if there is no response. Once Geek Plus is back up, a user can specify the command GUID and resend the command to Geek Plus.

AGV Active Error and Error Activity Records: Active error records include the robot code or name, error code, error description, and Sort GUID. The Sort GUID identifies the sort during which the error occurred. The source states that when an error is resolved or the AGV is removed, the record is archived to the AGVErrorActivityDatabaseModel.

WCS primary server as the access point for active AGV error queries: The manual states that the user logs into the WCS primary server and opens the WCS database before working with the active AGV error query. This establishes the WCS primary server and WCS database as the source-specific environment used for this error visibility task.

Active AGV error record fields returned by the query: The SQL query selects the following columns from SystemActiveErrorModel: Id, EntityInserted, EntityLastUpdate, Name, Area, Error, LastSeen, SystemErrorDescription, and SystemErrorResolution. These fields define the data elements shown when active errors are retrieved in this source.

Query tab and results area used to display active AGV errors: The manual indicates that a new query tab is opened in the interface, the query is placed there, and the active errors then appear in a designated results area. This establishes a source-specific screen context consisting of a query editor tab and a results display region.
